description: GraphML conformance corpus: the GraphML primer, library test suites (graphology, TinkerPop, Boost, igraph, OGDF, Gephi, Cytoscape, GraphStream, Tulip), real exporters (yEd, yFiles for HTML, graph-tool, Gephi, networkx, APOC), graphdrawing.org North samples, and authored XML-layer cases (encodings, entity attacks, malformed input).
